mapper.select: select password,error_times_limit as errorTimesLimit, lock_time as lockTime,lock_time_unit as lockTimeUnit from vm_uav_flight_control_password_conf t where device_code = #{deviceCode} and password_status = 1 ${dataScope}
SELECT NICK_NAME FROM `sys_user` where is_tenant_admin = 1 and tenant_id = #{tenantId} limit 1
select device_code from vm_uav_device_info_t where (uav_nest_code = #{deviceCode} or device_code = #{deviceCode})

SELECT biz_address_name AS bizAddressName FROM adm_address_stack_cfg
ROUND(6378.138*2*ASIN(SQRT(POW(SIN((#{latitude}*PI()/180-lat*PI()/180)/2),2)+COS(#{latitude}*PI()/180)*COS(lat*PI()/180)*POW(SIN((#{longitude}*PI()/180-lng*PI()/180)/2),2)))*1000) <= 3000
order by ROUND(6378.138*2*ASIN(SQRT(POW(SIN((#{latitude}*PI()/180-lat*PI()/180)/2),2)+COS(#{latitude}*PI()/180)*COS(lat*PI()/180)*POW(SIN((#{longitude}*PI()/180-lng*PI()/180)/2),2)))*1000) asc limit 1

select model.model_name, model.domain, model.type, model.sub_type, model.aircraft_category, model.aircraft_type, model.weight as modelWeight, model.support_camera, model.max_fly_time, model.max_level_speed, model.manufacturer_code as modelManufacturerCode, (select DICT_LABEL FROM sys_dict_data where DICT_TYPE = 'uav_model_manufacturer' AND DICT_VALUE = model.manufacturer_code limit 1) modelManufacturerName from vm_uav_device_model_t model where model.delete_flag = 0 and model.model_code = #{uavModelCode}
